description: SS_TopK calls int.is_integer(), unavailable before Python 3.12, while the repository specifies no minimum Python version.
trigger: Python 3.10 or 3.11 with assertions enabled constructs SS_TopK with an integer top_k through a non-greedy sampler route.
expected_behavior: Accept integral top-K counts on otherwise supported Python versions without requiring a newer int method.
actual_behavior: The new assertion attempts top_k.is_integer() and raises AttributeError for int on Python 3.10/3.11. Before 136 integer values were stored directly.

introductions.rationale: 136 introduces the assertion; reviewer cites Python release-note documented addition of int.is_integer in 3.12.

observations.description: Missed finding in 136; required before canonical use, while ancestor approval remains.

verification.description: Reviewer inspected new assertion, sampler construction and documented Python method availability.
verification.limits: No Python 3.10/3.11 execution performed; source verdict is retained as evidence, not represented as a newly fetched documentation page.

affected_revisions.limits: Reviewer observation at 136 only; no descendant range asserted.

reach: ComboSampler with integer top_k, including default 0, unless temperature is 0 or top_k is 1.
chat.py default sampler construction after integer parsing change.
canonical_use_condition: 136 entry needs this compatibility finding or a later attempt stating it; no teacher-input injection authorized.
